description: Worker queue health (P0-030, NFR-62): depth per queue, enqueue/dequeue rates, per-stage durations, plus worker heartbeats (P0-080): in-flight jobs, heartbeat age and live workers. Series come from the worker's QueueMetrics hooks (P0-029) and WorkerMetrics (P0-080); values flow once the queue implementation lands (E0.8, P0-075+).

panels.description: Jobs waiting per queue. Sustained growth here means workers are not keeping up (see the queue-age alert, P0-031).
panels.title: Queue depth

panels.description: Jobs per second entering vs leaving each queue (5m rate).
panels.title: Enqueue / dequeue rate

panels.description: Per-stage duration quantiles (5m rate on the stage histogram). Long inpaint tails are expected for 4K images; a rising qc tail is a quality-gate smell.
panels.title: Stage duration p50 / p95

panels.description: Total pipeline stage runs recorded so far.
panels.title: Stage runs observed

panels.description: Jobs inside a handler right now per worker (fetched, not yet acked). Sustained > 0 with no dequeue progress means a stuck handler.
panels.title: Worker in-flight jobs

panels.description: Seconds since each worker's last heartbeat row write (15 s interval). Older than ~30 s means the worker is dead or wedged — staleness IS the signal (P0-080).
panels.title: Worker heartbeat age

panels.description: Worker processes reporting a heartbeat (detag_worker_info). Zero here with jobs queued means no worker is running.
panels.title: Live workers

title: Detag queues
